title: FeatureFlagBody
description: The request body for creating a new feature flag.

name.description: The human-readable name of the feature flag.

key.description: The unique key identifying this feature flag.

description.description: A description of the feature flag purpose.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the feature flag.

variations.description: The variations this flag can serve.

temporary.description: Whether this flag is intended to be temporary.

usingEnvironmentId.description: Whether this flag is available to client-side SDKs using the environment ID.

usingMobileKey.description: Whether this flag is available to mobile SDKs.

defaults.description: Default variation settings for new environments.

onVariation.description: The index of the variation to serve when the flag is on.

offVariation.description: The index of the variation to serve when the flag is off.
